caption:
🚆 One day of trains in Great Britain — 24 hours, every service.

22,264 scheduled services across 2,584 stations. Watch London: almost every line points to it, and the whole network pulses to its commuter rush. Then the country empties overnight while the Caledonian Sleeper heads north to Scotland 🌙

📊 Data: National Rail GTFS via travelwhiz, RDG/ATOC data (CC BY 4.0), Thursday 3 September 2026. Positions interpolated between stops; stations joined in straight lines.
